name: trustguard
description: TrustGuard AI firewall for Claude Code (lifecycle hooks) plus TrustGate MCP Gateway. Set the MCP URL in the plugin options (Configure options / --config), not in the Add connector dialog. Collector key: ~/.trustguard/claude-code.json or Kandji.

trustgate_mcp_url.title: TrustGate MCP URL
trustgate_mcp_url.description: Full MCP endpoint from TrustGate Connect, e.g. https://host/consumer-slug/mcp.

trustgate_mcp_api_key.title: TrustGate MCP API key
trustgate_mcp_api_key.description: Optional consumer API key (X-AG-API-Key). Leave empty for OAuth. Not the TrustGuard tgk_… collector key.

trustgate_gateway_slug.title: TrustGate gateway slug
trustgate_gateway_slug.description: Optional X-AG-Gateway-Slug for hybrid / private data planes. Leave empty on SaaS.
